complexity.notes: Initializing best_buy to 100 is a latent correctness bug: since prices range 1..1000, prices below 100 (or entirely above 100) produce wrong results, e.g. prices=[150,160] yields 50 instead of 10. Use float('inf') or prices[0] instead. Iterating with 'for p in prices:' would also be more idiomatic than indexing.
complexity.summary: Single pass tracking the minimum buy price seen so far and the maximum profit achievable by selling at the current price.
